label: converse-room-change
note: Regression for a room change after a conversation (tester report, 18 Nov). Recorded from a native run with the fix applied, from the walkthrough's chapter 2 save in slot 12 (inn bar, room 14), routed to room 18. The player wears the earplugs, talks to the man in room 18 (55), and takes his test (choose 2). The conversation's diffs go out from the converse hook; when it ends the game puts the hero back in room 17. Before the fix poll() assumed the talk's diff carried that move, so no line named room 17 and the player kept room 18's list until the next command failed with 'object 55 is not in this room'. With the fix, poll() emits room 17's state straight after the choose 2 diff.
